answer: The copper counter is kept in plume and dawn reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Someone therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4667 identities would post 2738 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
